name: 89423 · Minden, NV
findings: ZIP 89423 (Minden) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89423 (Minden) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89423 (Minden) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
